mimo-copilot.description: Use MiMo, DeepSeek, and OpenAI Responses-compatible models in Copilot Chat. Vision, thinking mode, tools, memory mode, multi-provider BYOK.
mimo-copilot.config.agenticMemory.descri: Enable agentic memory system. Injects relevant memories from previous conversations using a lightweight agent model.
mimo-copilot.config.memory.recallModel.d: Lightweight model used for memory recall (default: mimo-v2-pro).
mimo-copilot.config.memory.dreamInterval: Hours between auto-dream memory optimization runs (default: 24).
mimo-copilot.config.memory.dreamMinSessi: Minimum sessions before auto-dream can trigger (default: 5).
mimo-copilot.walkthrough.title: MiMo for Copilot Chat
mimo-copilot.walkthrough.description: Set up MiMo & DeepSeek models in Copilot Chat.
mimo-copilot.walkthrough.setApiKey.title: Set your MiMo / DeepSeek API key
mimo-copilot.walkthrough.setApiKey.descr:
Get an API key from your provider.
[Set API Key](command:mimo-copilot.setApiKey)
mimo-copilot.walkthrough.showModels.desc:
If the models are hidden, open VS Code's Language Models manager and show them.
[Open Language Models](command:workbench.action.chat.manage)
mimo-copilot.config.title: MiMo Copilot
mimo-copilot.config.baseUrl.description: API base URL. Defaults to official DeepSeek API endpoint.
mimo-copilot.config.providers.descriptio: API providers configuration. Each provider has its own base URL, API mode, and API key (stored securely). Supports MiMo, DeepSeek, and OpenAI Responses-compatible providers. Use the 'Open Provider Configuration' command for a visual editor.
mimo-copilot.config.models.description: User-configured models. Each model is linked to a provider and can be tuned with context, output, tool, reasoning, and sampling options. Use the 'Open Provider Configuration' command for a visual editor.
mimo-copilot.config.hiddenModels.descrip: IDs of built-in models hidden from the model picker. Manage via the Provider Configuration page.
mimo-copilot.config.maxTokens.descriptio: Maximum number of output tokens per request. Set to 0 to use the API default (no limit). Useful for controlling costs.
mimo-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.des: Override the API model ID sent for each model. Defaults are prefilled with official IDs.
mimo-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.dee: API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Flash
API model ID for DeepSeek V4 Pro
mimo-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.mim: API model ID for MiMo V2.5 Pro
API model ID for MiMo V2.5
mimo-copilot.config.modelIdOverrides.gpt: API model ID for GPT-5.4 Responses model
API model ID for GPT-5.5 Responses model
mimo-copilot.config.responses.log.expand: Expand Responses debug logs with larger request/error previews. Keep disabled unless diagnosing provider or streaming issues because logs may become large.
configView.responses.runtimeDescription: Control waiting and no-feedback reconnect behavior for OpenAI Responses-compatible providers.
configView.responses.waitThresholdHint: If no output token arrives after this many seconds, the output-rate status bar shows a waiting timer.
configView.responses.enableReconnectHint: When enabled, fully silent Responses streams are automatically replayed after the no-feedback timeout.
configView.responses.noFeedbackReconnect: If the Responses stream produces no SSE feedback for this many seconds, MiMo reconnects unless the stream already has visible progress.
configView.responses.maxReconnectAttempt: After this many no-feedback failures, the output-rate status shows connect Error.
mimo-copilot.config.responses.waitingFor: Seconds to wait after sending a request before showing a waiting-for-response timer when no output token has arrived.
mimo-copilot.config.responses.enableNoFe: Enable automatic reconnect/replay when a Responses stream produces no SSE feedback before the timeout.
mimo-copilot.config.responses.noFeedback: Seconds to wait for any Responses SSE feedback before reconnecting. Only fully silent streams are replayed; partial streams are finalized to avoid duplicate tool calls.
mimo-copilot.config.responses.maxNoFeedb: Maximum number of no-feedback reconnect failures before showing connect Error.
mimo-copilot.config.responses.outputRate: Seconds between Output Rate status bar tooltip refreshes. The status bar text can update faster while the tooltip refreshes slower to avoid flicker.
mimo-copilot.config.outputRate.chartStyl: Visual style for the Output Rate chart. Classic keeps the current segmented line, Neon adds glow, and Hybrid adds subtle rate bars behind the line.
mimo-copilot.config.visionModel.descript: Model ID for vision proxy. Leave empty for auto-detection.
mimo-copilot.config.visionPrompt.descrip: Prompt sent to the vision proxy model when describing image attachments.
